answer: Sybil defence here is stake-weighted uniqueness, not free identity: each credential must lock a bond before it can claim emission. Every epoch the protocol samples a challenge and slashes the entire bond when two credentials return identical proofs, which is cheap to detect but impossible to fake apart, since copying means forfeiting the stake. Payout is a fixed pool split by distinct credentials, so an extra fake dilutes everyone: the attacker funds another bond yet earns one honest share. The atlas, crystal, and zenith benchmarks pay only the honest set, so extra identities lose money.
